title_detail.value: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt

summary: Beginning September 2026, USCIS mandates that Green Card applicants prove financial self-sufficiency to address public charge inadmissibility. This applies mainly to those pursuing family or employment-based applications, though exemptions exist for humanitarian categories such as refugees and trafficking survivors. The Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is essential but doesn't alone assure application approval. In cases of inadmissibility on public charge terms, Public Charge Bonds are an available recourse.

The order was notified through the Government Gazette and treats the department as an intelligence and security organisation.The Public (Law & Order) Department handles a wide range of sensitive matters, including communal and caste clashes, law-and-order reviews, preventive detention matters, police firing inquiries, custodial death-related reports, agitations and other security-related issues. n18oc_breaking-newsn18oc_india News18 Mobile App - https://onelink.to/desc-youtube
